build_scope: Full SmartNIC streaming AXI4 DMA subsystem coupling 4-port axi_dma_desc_mux instances on read and write descriptor channels with axi_dma (axi_dma_rd + axi_dma_wr), plus multi-parameter 4-state Icarus Verilog (PORTS=1, PORTS=3, 256-bit AXI_MAX_BURST_LEN=128) and Yosys synthesis/latch checks.
